title: Priority music: 12 tracks, 3 variants each, stems for the match tracks
owner_gate: owner listens to the shortlist of each track after the seam gate (seam-flux/gate.py); key mismatches are accepted per track (the model keeps the key in 12 of 17 tracks)

budget.hard_stop_rule: nominal + 15%: above that the run stops and the owner is asked
assumptions: separate_stems is not quoted: 5 cr per track is an assumption
reserve 25% = 59.7 cr is one pool task

candidates_policy: 3 variants per track (456 s of material x 3 variants x 0.1453 cr/s = 198.8 cr), stems for 8 tracks (assumed 5 cr), reserve 25% for re-takes

criteria: loop seam inaudible (no click, no tail), starts on the groove
hook recognisable but does not distract in match tracks
key and tempo within the intended zone (log mismatches)

pilot.go_rule: owner looks at the pilot frames; any red-line or drift failure -> fix the prompt before the full run

tool_note: elevenlabs_music_v2_5 (force_instrumental true, batch_size = variants), then separate_stems(four) only for tracks flagged with stems. Prompts follow AUDIO_BIBLE 9.2.
guards: Before each launch: estimate_*_cost -> quote_ref; abort the task when the quote is above max_credits.
Actual spend goes to design/art_batches/SPEND_LOG.csv; more than 15% over the batch nominal = stop and ask the owner.
Every output lands in assets/incoming, then double anatomy audit -> metadata scrub -> watermark pass -> manifest `approve`.
Prompts are untested: run the pilot tasks first (2-3 frames), look at them, only then release the rest.

tasks.prompt: Riichi table music, a focused premium mahjong table at night in a magical East-Asian teahouse. Calm, intense, grown-up, never aggressive. Lead melody on guzheng with a soft erhu answer, warm Rhodes piano chords, soft analog synth pads, soft lo-fi drums with brushed snare, warm upright-style bass, pizzicato strings and woodblock accents. Built on a short hummable five-note pentatonic hook. Anime-pop fusion with traditional Chinese instruments, 92 BPM, A minor pentatonic leaning major. Seamless loop: no intro, no fade-in, no fade-out, no ending, starts directly on the groove. Instrumental only.

Finale layer for a calm puzzle game, the last pairs of tiles, almost there. Sparkling anticipation, 8 bars. Rising guzheng runs over a pulsing synth bass, bell-like synth, light risers, warm piano chords, the same hook as a calm lo-fi puzzle loop at 88 BPM in A minor pentatonic leaning major. Tight ending that resolves on the tonic, no fade-out. Instrumental only.

Results screen underscore, soft and rewarding, premium anime mobile game. Warm piano and gentle bell-like synth over a slow guzheng arpeggio, soft pad, very light brushed percussion, 84 BPM, D major pentatonic. Satisfied, calm, grown-up. Seamless loop: no intro, no fade-in, no fade-out, no ending. Instrumental only.

Seasonal event theme for a premium anime mahjong game in a festive lantern market. Joyful, warm, festive, grown-up, not childish. Lead melody on plucky koto and guzheng doubled by bell-like synth, erhu countermelody, bright piano chords, light anime-pop drums with shaker and hand claps, gentle bass, finger snaps. Instantly hummable five-note pentatonic hook. 110 BPM, G major pentatonic. Seamless loop: no intro, no fade-in, no fade-out, no ending. Instrumental only.

Short high-energy event fever sting-loop, festive lantern market at its peak. Driving 128 BPM four-on-the-floor kick, taiko accents, bright guzheng and synth lead, rising energy, anime-pop EDM costume, C major pentatonic. Joyful, energetic, never aggressive. Seamless loop. Instrumental only.

Memorial scene theme for the mahjong salon owner, a heartfelt quiet moment at dawn in a teahouse. Tender, nostalgic, warm and grateful, never sad. Solo guzheng and warm piano with a soft erhu countermelody, light string pad, almost no percussion, 72 BPM, D major pentatonic. Gentle build to a warm resolution, soft ending, instrumental only.

Memorial scene theme for a serene moon-palace ruler, a hushed night under a silver moon. Elegant, mysterious, tender, never scary. Solo pipa and soft piano with a slow erhu line, airy synth pads and distant bells, no drums, 3/4 waltz feel at 80 BPM, B minor pentatonic. Gentle resolution, soft ending, instrumental only.

Memorial scene theme for a firebird tsarevna of a fairy-tale kingdom, a warm glowing hearth at night. Proud, warm, nostalgic, never sad. Folk-inspired melody on gusli-like plucked strings and warm piano with a soft cello line, gentle pads, hand drum very soft, 78 BPM, E minor pentatonic leaning major. Gentle resolution, soft ending, instrumental only.

Short leitmotif for a firebird tsarevna, regal and warm. Bright plucked gusli-like melody doubled by bells, warm piano chords, light hand drum, 108 BPM, E minor pentatonic leaning major. Instantly hummable hook stated twice. Seamless loop. Instrumental only.

Short leitmotif for a white fox shrine maiden, playful and mysterious. Plucky koto melody with a shakuhachi answer, soft bells, light percussion with wood blocks, 104 BPM, A minor pentatonic leaning major. Instantly hummable hook stated twice. Seamless loop. Instrumental only.

Classic solitaire mode loop, serene tea garden. Calm, meditative, grown-up. Slow guzheng arpeggios and sparse warm piano, soft pad, no drums, 72 BPM, G major pentatonic. Seamless loop: no intro, no fade-in, no fade-out, no ending. Instrumental only.

Short rare-reveal sting for a premium gacha summon: silence-to-sparkle, rising bell-like synth and guzheng glissando into a golden major chord with a soft shimmer tail, C major. Resolves and rings out, no loop. Instrumental only.
